description.value:
Requires: Ki Rank 2 You have been taught how to place a piece of your soul into an area, pulling it from the ground into your own floating sanctum.

As an 8 hour Ritual you may meditate, placing your soul into the planet or a structure no larger than an island, causing it to rip from the ground and fly into the sky. While on your Lookout, you have advantage on all Sense Ki Checks you make. At the center of your island resides a spiritual place, from this location you may spend an Action and gain a Rank of Exhaustion to teleport you and any creatures you are touching to the Gates of Otherworld.

You may use this Trained Feature so long as you are at the Gates of Otherworld or Yemma's Reception Desk to transport you and any creatures you are touching to your Lookout.

system.tags: trained feature; Guardian of the Dragon Balls
